ValidationRule.description: Validation rule that enforces the user to fill in the phone nr of the mobile nr.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ISPICKVAL(ER_BUPicklist__c, 'BENELUX'), NOT(ISBLANK( FirstName )), NOT(ISBLANK( LastName )), ISBLANK(MobilePhone ), ISBLANK(Phone ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Phone nr of Mobile nr needs to be filled in.
